title: Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI)
definition: A statutory advisory body established in 1962 under Section 4 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (PCA) Act, 1960, to promote animal welfare and prevent unnecessary pain or suffering to animals.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding statutory status, nodal ministry, and composition; relevant for Mains in the context of Ethics (Animal Rights vs. Human Utility) and Environment (Biodiversity Conservation).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Animal Welfare Board.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
